# BB00674 {.unnumbered}

Write thou the first verse on the Day of Thursday upon green silk, together with ten exalted invocations, and keep it with thee. Then write thou the second verse on the Day of Tuesday, and wash it with water, and drink it, for love of Him. Verily God—were He to will—would, through this, grant thee thine asking. He is, in truth, the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.
